Title: Molecular Prediction Model Fine-Tuning (MolPMoFiT) encodings
Description: Represents a molecule as 400 features drawn from MolPMoFiT, an AWD-LSTM language model that Li and Fourches pretrained on one million unlabelled ChEMBL structures by adapting the ULMFiT inductive transfer learning recipe from natural language, then fine-tuned for lipophilicity, solvation, HIV activity and blood-brain barrier penetration. Only the pretrained model is served here, not any fine-tuned endpoint, and the vector is the mean of the normalised token embedding weights of the SMILES symbols, so it records composition rather than sequence context.
Interpretation: Mean of the 400-dimensional token embeddings a ChEMBL-pretrained language model assigns to each SMILES symbol.
